simulationIndexing.title: Simulations in the knowledge base
simulationIndexing.auto: Index every simulation when it finishes
simulationIndexing.autoDesc: Adds to the project's knowledge base a summary of the run, its statistics, the elements outside their thresholds and what changed since the previous run. This is what lets you ask the chat what problems the last simulation found.
simulationIndexing.raw: Also index the full time series
simulationIndexing.rawDesc: Additionally stores the raw results, step by step. It does not improve the chat's answers —that is what the summaries are for— and takes up far more space; it is meant for fine-tuning stages.
simulationIndexing.thresholdsDesc: The regulatory reference varies by country. The defaults are the values in common use: pressure between 14 and 70 m —in rural water systems the minimum drops to 7— and a maximum velocity of 3 m/s.
simulationIndexing.inherited: Inherited from the general settings; they part ways as soon as you change something here.
simulationIndexing.ownSettings: This project has its own settings.

versionHistory.title: Version history
versionHistory.retentionDesc: Versions marked as milestones and those held by a project snapshot are never pruned, whatever the count says. Neither is the most recent one, even if you set zero.

python.title: Python (WNTR)
python.pathDesc: Boorie detects Python automatically and prefers your system's. Set the path here only if WNTR lives in an environment it cannot find (conda, your own venv or an installation outside the usual paths).

networkHistory.title: History of {{network}}
networkHistory.description: Each version is a different scenario of the network it came from. They are never modified: they are added, marked as milestones and can be restored.

networkHistory.syntheticQualityHelp: This run did not simulate water quality: the figures were generated by an earlier version of Boorie to fill the screen. Run it again for real data.
